text:
elaine (PM): Quick sync — we need a decision on scope for the "visibility-lite" console effort. AcmeHealth pushed for per-route traces + cost breakdown before GA. Do we bite that for v1 or split into phases?

devon (eng): Per-route tracing is non-trivial. If we enable full-span export for every route we’ll blow up storage and latency. Suggest sampling + enriched span tags for v1.

raj (eng-sre): +1. Prefer two constraints: (1) keep agent overhead <5% p95 CPU, (2) limit retained traces to top-N routes.

maria (design): From UX: customers care most about being able to correlate high-cost routes to errors/latency quickly. If we can surface a "route insights" card with cost + error-rate + sample trace, that covers a lot.

sophie (cs): AcmeHealth says compliance team requires per-route cost attribution for billing audits. They need CSV export for route-level cost and tags.

josh (sales): Echo — multiple enterprise prospects mentioned the same audit use-case. This is a conversion blocker for Dedicated/Private deals.

elaine (PM): Proposal A: "Cost-first v1" — ship per-route cost breakdown + route insights card + CSV export, with lightweight sampled traces (1%) for top-10 routes. Proposal B: "Tracing-first v1" — full sampling for errors + lower-fidelity cost estimates.

devon (eng): Cost-first v1 has much lower infra change: we can compute cost attribution from token/router-level metadata and annotations. Tracing-first forces span collection pipeline changes.

raj (eng-sre): Also: cost-first allows us to iterate on computation windows (hourly vs per-request) before adding heavy tracing. Recommend cost-first + quick trace samples.

maria (design): Design-wise cost-first gives us a clean dashboard to prototype. We can wire the sampled traces into the insights card later without UX churn.

sophie (cs): If we go cost-first, ask AcmeHealth to test CSV export with a short pilot — they'd likely accept a staged rollout.

ejob (deploy-bot): canary created: visibility-lite-canary-2026-03. Targets: acme-pilot, beta-corp, internal-test.

elaine (PM): Draft launch criteria for cost-first v1 — please react with :thumbsup: if ok or :thinking: if concerns: 

```
Acceptance criteria (cost-first v1):
- Per-route cost breakdown (hourly aggregation) visible in Console
- Route insights card: cost, p50/p95 latency, error-rate, top sampled trace (1%)
- CSV export of per-route cost & tags
- Canary rollout to 3 pilot orgs + smoke tests green for 48h
- CPU overhead <5% on dataplane during pilot
- Documentation + quickstart for customers
```

devon (eng): :thumbsup: we can hit that in a 6-sprint slice if we limit to hourly agg and top-10 routes for the insights card.

raj (eng-sre): :thinking: need explicit SLOs for trace retention and a fail-open for the dataplane if exporter backpressure occurs. Add a gating item: exporter backpressure circuit-breaker.

maria (design): :thumbsup: will produce mockups for desktop + narrow screens by EOD Thu.

sophie (cs): i'll message AcmeHealth about a 2-week pilot window and confirm CSV spec.

josh (sales): i'll attach the pilot agreement to the ticket; helps enterprise renewals.

elaine (PM): Plan: ship cost-first v1 with sampled traces, iterate tracing capabilities in v1.1. Action items: 
- devon: tech spec for cost aggregation + tagging by Tue
- raj: circuit-breaker + canary runbook by Wed
- maria: mockups by Thu
- sophie/josh: pilot confirmation by Fri

elaine (PM): If no strong objections by EOD today I’ll lock scope and open the PRD.

devon (eng): no objections from eng side.

raj (eng-sre): no objections if circuit-breaker is mandatory.

maria (design): no objections.

sophie (cs): ok.

josh (sales): ok.

elaine (PM): Great — locking scope. Creating PRD and roadmap ticket now. Will paste PRD link when ready. :raised_hands:
